title: A changed home and established order

captions.physics: Choosing domestic solutions through considered experience
captions.energy: Keeping former rules despite changed conditions
captions.emotions: Feeling an old domestic form ending

meaning: Your domestic support keeps its meaning when accumulated experience helps end an unnecessary form of order instead of preserving it after needs have changed.
text: You can arrange domestic life through considered understanding: identifying a need, choosing a method and using accumulated experience. The Hermit in the physical position of Muladhara describes these actions. The Emperor in energy complicates support through rigid preservation of established order. Death in emotions feels that a previous form has run its course. Tension emerges between the reasonable basis of an earlier solution and the experience of its ending. A once suitable method continues determining the home although everyday needs are now different.

For example, a separate table once served shared work but now only collects belongings. Removing it is difficult because its place was carefully planned. **Ending a form does not cancel the experience that helped create it.** You can recognise its former usefulness and release the space. Thoughtfulness then serves present life instead of preserving an object as permanent proof that an old decision was reasonable and worth the effort invested.

The difficulty is permitting only superficial alterations while the basic arrangement remains untouchable. Objects move, but inconvenience returns because the question now concerns the need itself. Support grows through allowing a specific domestic solution to end without assessing the entire history of your home. Experience stays with you after a form no longer needs to occupy shared space.
